title: 第9章 牢房里的神秘老人第10章 墨竹轩有七朵小金花
lines: 二人出了主殿，来到了大殿的后面。
后面有两排青砖建造的房屋，大概三四十间。
这些房舍并不高大，也不豪华。
不少房屋门前还晾着衣服，应该是戒律院一些弟子平日里居住的。
由于整个云海宗的房屋殿宇都是依山而建，很快许开便领着叶风来到了一面山壁前。
“许师兄，带我到一块石壁面前干什么？我不想尿尿……”
叶风疑惑的询问着。
许开有些厌恶的看了他一眼，并没有说话。
而是伸手右掌，并指为剑，口中念咒。
忽然，他的指尖竟然泛起淡淡的青光。
他手指在面前画了一个圆，光芒如烟，凝而不散，形成了一个青色的太极图。
他手指一点，太极图忽然飞向了面前的岩壁。
呼！
太极图没入岩壁之内，整块坚硬无比巨大岩壁，竟然泛起了宛如水幕一般的涟漪。
这一幕看的叶风是直瞪双眼，大呼好厉害！
“许师兄，这是什么法术神通？好厉害的啊！
连岩石都能融化！”
“法术？不不不，这只是一道禁制结界。”
许开说话间，伸手推了一下叶风。
叶风身体立刻撞在了水幕结界之上。
然后就感觉身体一个踉跄，栽倒下去。
定睛一看，却见自已出现在了一条昏暗的岩石通道中。
许开此刻也穿过了那层水幕结界走了进来。
“叶师弟，这里你应该很熟悉吧。”
许开的语气有些戏谑。
“熟悉？我以前来过这里？”
叶风面露惊疑。
“当然，你可是这里的常客。”
许开拽起叶风，他在前面走着，口中道：“这里是戒律院的石牢，里面有十二个牢房，几百年来，只关着一个疯子，自从你被玉龙师叔带回山之后，每年至少为你开两次。”
听到许开的回答，叶风心中是一阵无语。
他现在已经对身体的原主有了一个大概的了解。
坏。
透到骨子里的坏！
不论是在影视剧还是小说中，这种人都是不折不扣的反派。
先前叶风还断定，原主的死，是因为药圃丢失灵草仙芝被人灭口的。
现在他对自已的推断产生了怀疑。
没准云霜儿那大美妞说对了，是某位少侠在替天行道。
content_en:
The two of them left the main hall and came to the back of the hall.
There are two rows of blue brick houses at the back, about thirty or forty rooms.
These houses are neither tall nor luxurious.
There are still clothes hanging in front of many houses, which should be where some disciples of the Discipline Academy live.
Since the entire Yunhaizong's houses and palaces were built against the mountain, Xu Kai soon led Ye Feng to a mountain wall.
"Senior Brother Xu, why are you taking me to a stone wall? I don't want to pee..."
Ye Feng asked doubtfully.
Xu Kai glanced at him with disgust and said nothing.
Instead, he stretched out his right palm, pointed it as a sword, and recited a mantra.
Suddenly, his fingertips glowed with a faint green light.
He drew a circle in front of him with his fingers, and the light was like smoke, condensing and not dissipating, forming a cyan Tai Chi diagram.
He pointed a finger, and Tai Chi Tu suddenly flew towards the rock wall in front of him.
call!
The Tai Chi Diagram was submerged into the rock wall, and the entire rock wall was extremely hard and huge, and ripples appeared like a water curtain.
Ye Feng stared at this scene and shouted, "It's so awesome!"
"Senior Brother Xu, what kind of magical power is this? It's so powerful!
Even rocks can melt! "
"Spell? No, no, no, this is just a forbidden barrier."
While Xu Kai was speaking, he reached out and pushed Ye Feng.
Ye Feng's body immediately hit the water curtain barrier.
Then I felt my body stagger and fell down.
Taking a closer look, he saw himself appearing in a dim rock passage.
Xu Kai also walked in through the water curtain barrier at this moment.
"Junior Brother Ye, you should be familiar with this place."
Xu Kai's tone was a little joking.
"Familiar? Have I been here before?"
Ye Feng looked surprised.
"Of course, you are a regular visitor here."
Xu Kai pulled Ye Feng up, and he walked in front, saying: "This is the stone prison of the Discipline Academy. There are twelve cells in it. For hundreds of years, only one madman has been imprisoned. Since you were brought back to the mountain by Master Yulong, he has been opened for you at least twice a year."
Hearing Xu Kai's answer, Ye Feng was speechless.
He now had a rough idea of ​​the original owner of the body.
bad.
Bad to the core!
Whether in movies, TV series or novels, this kind of person is an out-and-out villain.
Ye Feng had previously concluded that the original owner's death was due to the loss of the magical grass and fairy zhi from the medicine garden.
Now he doubted his own reasoning.
Maybe that beautiful girl Yun Shuang'er was right, it was a certain young hero doing justice for heaven.
